changes.result: Replaced the shared boolean with an explicit planned, applying, recovery-available, recovering, and closed state machine shared by every plan and recovery-token clone.

A failed effect plus failed automatic restore now arms recovery only for a valid adapter-observed state that exactly matches the deterministic completed-effect prefix and carries recovery-required state.

Recovery before or during apply, duplicate clones, replay, transport, public-field mutation, planned-final substitution, newer-generation drift, candidate substitution, and unmodeled observations refuse before recovery-adapter effects.

findings.finding: Apply no longer consumes recovery authority before effects; recovery becomes available only after apply reaches a state with an exact sealed recovery observation.
Failed automatic restore no longer relies on caller-fabricated plan.expected_after; it binds one recovery action to the actual modeled partial state and refuses unrelated or newer authority.
